title.narrative: The launch of the Health Sector Transformation Project improved primary health care access through increased number of supported health facilities from 280 in 2023 to 816 in 2024, and malaria control efforts strengthened. UNICEF’s support led to the expansion of access to health-care services, resulting in increased testing and treatment capabilities. Over one million children were screened for malaria, and half a million long-lasting insecticidal nets were distributed to protect over a million people.
